groups.name: Facilities Admins
groups.description: People who manage meeting rooms and bookings

roles.name: Staff
roles.description: Browses rooms and availability, books slots and cancels their own bookings. Never cancels or sees anything of other people's bookings beyond who holds a slot, and never manages rooms.

roles.name: FacilitiesAdmin
roles.description: Adds, edits, deactivates and reactivates rooms, sees every room and the day's availability with who booked each slot, and cancels any upcoming booking. Does not book rooms.
